title: Minecraft chess
description: Resource pack that will allow you to play chess in Minecraft
body:
### [Optifine](https://optifine.net/downloads) needed or [CIT-resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)

Resource pack that will allow you to play chess in Minecraft!

__________________________________________________________________________________________

So that you can play chess, you need to rename the paper on the anvil to the names written below, create a chessboard on the floor and place a frame on each block, then arrange the pieces by their names and play!

__________________________________________________________________________________________

To get chess you need to rename the paper on the anvil like this:
Для получения шахват вам нужно переименовать бумагу на наковальне так:

For black chess:
- king-king_b
- bishop-bishop_b
- queen-queen_b
- pawn-pawn_b
- rook-rook_b

ru:
- Король - Король чёрный
- Слон - Слон чёрный
- Ферзь - Ферзь чёрный
- Пешка - Пешка чёрная
- Ладья - Ладья чёрная

For white chess:
- king-king
- bishop-bishop
- queen-queen
- pawn-pawn
- rook-rook

ru:
- Король - Король
- Слон - Слон
- Ферзь - Ферзь
- Пешка - Пешка
- Ладья - Ладья

**Have fun!**
